title: Tight Time-Memory Trade-Offs Beyond Streaming
summary: The streaming model is the current boundary for tight trade-off proofs; the unresolved task is to extend techniques to more complex symmetric-encryption security games.

formal_statement.body: No proof technique is known for establishing tight time--memory trade-offs in symmetric-encryption security games outside the streaming model. Develop such techniques, including for games with decryption-oracle access.

scope.domain: Symmetric-encryption security games and tight time-memory trade-offs beyond the streaming model.
parameters: Time and memory, the resources in the trade-off
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop proof techniques for tight time-memory trade-offs in symmetric-encryption security games outside the streaming model, including games with decryption-oracle access.

citations.label: Tight Time-Memory Trade-Offs for Symmetric Encryption

progress.summary: The source presents this in its Open Questions section, noting that it does not know how to prove trade-offs for more complex security games outside the streaming model. It gives security in the presence of decryption oracles as an example.
citation_labels: Joseph Jaeger et al., Tight Time-Memory Trade-Offs for Symmetric Encryption
